```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

breeding_sites <- read.csv('data/breeding_site_locations.csv')
gt(breeding_sites)
```

```{r}
colnames(breeding_sites)
glimpse(breeding_sites)

print(nrow(breeding_sites))
print(ncol(breeding_sites))
print(dim(breeding_sites))
```

```{r}
migration_sites <- read.csv('data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv')
gt(head(migration_sites))
```

```{r}
glimpse(migration_sites)
```

```{r}
breeding_filtered <- breeding_sites |> 
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_longitude = Longitude, Breeding_latitude = Latitude)
gt(breeding_filtered)
```

```{r}
migration_filtered <- migration_sites |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)
gt(migration_filtered)
```

```{r}
breeding_no_spain = breeding_filtered |> filter(Site != 'Spain')
gt(breeding_no_spain)
migration_no_spain = migration_filtered |> filter(Site != 'Spain')
gt(migration_no_spain)
```
